comment: kiln.markers' map tooltip text (GitHub issue 160; docs/re/map.md "The tooltip's name"; client 26430625). markers.map_tooltip_text: what MapLabel.NativeTooltip rests on. The game names a map entry through one resolver, markers/MapName (client 0xd3d350, void(Name* out, const MapEntry*)): when the entry's text view (+0x50 pointer, +0x58 length, the same offsets as markers/entry.label) is not empty it is the name, through the game's own player-text path markers/PlayerText (0xd28af0: the platform's text filter when the game has one, '\\' and '<' escaped, a copy in the UI's string buffer); only after that come the custom-pin text (+0x68), the custom-pin types' "Custom marker" and the type's own name. The hover tooltip's texts (markers/TooltipTexts, 0xd1df80) start from it, and the map's crosshair window draws no tooltip when the name is empty (@markers/Crosshair.title). The game's append (0x302970) clears both text views of every entry it adds (@markers/Append.label), so a game row never takes over Kiln's text. Kiln writes the view only on its own rows, beyond the game's count, with bytes of its text arena (process lifetime); it calls and hooks nothing here: the symbols are guards, and the feature off keeps markers.map_text off. Checked by tools/sigport/tests/test_markers_map_text.py.
